claim: In mongo_extjson_unwrapper.go, ensureReconstructedMongoTimestamps synthesizes createdAt and updatedAt as primitive.DateTime from _source_ts or _id ObjectID timestamp when missing on a reconstructed MongoDB document, and ensures __v is int32(0).

In recon_engine_segment_b.go, resolveSegmentBTSCol only overwrites tsCol with dstTS when errTS == nil && dstTS != "" && dstTS != "_id_only", preserving tsCol = "_source_ts" when timestamp_field is NULL.

In recon_multi_shadow_b.go, shouldSkipMongoRowDiffCol returns true for source_field_types, sourceFieldTypes, source_field_values, sourceFieldValues, and stripped flat/optional columns that are nil on the MongoDB Master row.
In mongo_stale_field_pruner.go, StaleMongoKeysToPrune skips keys that start with "_", equal targetKey, or equal "source_field_types" or "sourceFieldTypes".
In mongo_stale_field_pruner.go, StaleMongoKeysToPrune only returns keys that start with an underscore "_" and deletes all non-underscore keys.
In recon_engine_segment_b.go, resolveSegmentBTSCol always returns "_id_only" when dstTS equals "_id_only".
